response.overview: A gang of criminals lures young women with promises of money, kidnaps them, and takes them to the south to sell them to Arab sheikhs. Meanwhile, Maryam, the niece of Sergeant Izadi, who is under his care, has caught the attention of both the chief constable and Ahmad, the neighborhood barber. Both men try to win her affection.
response.title: استوار و پاسبان
